A.rule: adopt iff the candidate passes C12 on ≥ 2/3 of the HO members where raw FVO fails, and ΔIC ≥ −1 SE; recorded only, never applied

B.rule: SIZERS_ENABLED iff IC(d·∏factor) − IC(d) ≥ −1 SE on HO claim rows, trust ≡ 1, causal β from the leave-one-out priors; call vs bare claim is information

C.rule: causal_tercile iff pooled payoff T1 < T2 < T3 among HO issued calls with n/h ≥ 20 per tercile

held_out.rule: universe − Gold, Nifty 50, S&P 500, USD/INR − daily log-return ρ ≥ 0.8 with any of them over [epoch, run date]
